info.title: LuxMap API
info.description: WP2 — GIS + IoT + Computer Vision platform for rural street-lighting assets. Base URL /api/v1. Conventions from API Contract v1.1: snake_case JSON, lowercase string enums, ISO 8601 UTC timestamps with a Z suffix, EPSG:4326 coordinates. Endpoint không ghi [Mobile]/[Web] là dùng chung, xác thực bằng Bearer access token.

Bearer.description: Paste the JWT here WITHOUT the 'Bearer ' prefix. Claims: role (one of superior, manager, field_engineer, system_admin — Contract v1.7 section 3.1) and commune_ids (always an array; ["*"] for system_admin only). Every business operation requires one capability, named in x-luxmap-capability, admitting exactly the roles in x-luxmap-roles — no ranking between roles. Matrix: cap:read_surveys = superior, manager, field_engineer, system_admin; cap:submit_surveys = field_engineer; cap:review_surveys = manager; cap:read_network = superior, manager, field_engineer, system_admin; cap:read_lux_readings = superior, manager, field_engineer, system_admin; cap:manage_assets = manager; cap:record_lux_reading = field_engineer; cap:control_lighting = manager; cap:manage_users = system_admin; cap:read_faults = superior, manager, field_engineer, system_admin; cap:review_faults = manager; cap:read_work_orders = superior, manager, field_engineer, system_admin; cap:manage_work_orders = manager; cap:execute_work_orders = field_engineer. 401 UNAUTHENTICATED: token missing, invalid or expired. 403 ROLE_FORBIDDEN: the role is not in the capability's list. 403 COMMUNE_FORBIDDEN: a commune_id outside the caller's scope, or ["*"] on a role other than system_admin.

RefreshTokenCookie.description: The web refresh token. HttpOnly: set by /api/v1/auth/web/login and /refresh, sent back by the browser, never readable from JavaScript.
